senses.gloss: ऊर्ध ऊर्धक, an incorrect spelling for ऊर्ध्व, ऊर्ध्वक below.

ऊर्ध्व॑ mf(आ)n. (√ वृध्, BRD.; perhaps fr. √ ऋ), rising or tending upwards, raised, elevated, erected, erect, upright, high, above, RV.; AV.; VS.; ŚBr.; AitBr. &c. (in class. Sanskṛt occurring generally in compounds)
ऊर्ध्व॑ (अम्), n. height, elevation, L.
anything placed above or higher (with abl.), L.
ऊर्ध्व [cf. Gk. ὀρθός; Lat. arduus; Gaël. ard.]
ऊर्ध्वा also f. the upper region (zenith), L.
ऊर्ध्व॑म् (अम्), ind. upwards, towards the upper part, aloft, above, in the upper regions, higher (with abl.), AV. xi, 1, 9; ŚBr. xii; KātyŚr.; MBh.; Mn. &c.
(ऊर्ध्वं-√ गम्, to go upwards or into heaven, die)
in the sequel, in the later part (e.g. of a book or MS.; because in Sanskṛt MSS. the later leaves stand above), subsequent, after (with abl.), ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Suśr.; Mn. &c.

(अत ऊर्ध्वम्, or इत ऊर्ध्वम्, hence forward, from that time forward, after that passage, hereafter, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr.; Yājñ. &c.; ऊर्ध्वं संवत्सरात्, after a year, Mn. ix, 77; ऊर्ध्वं देहात्, after life, after death, MBh. i, 3606)
after, after the death of (with abl., e.g. ऊर्ध्वं पितुः, after the father's death, Mn. ix, 104)
in a high tone, aloud, BhP.
